banner.title: The Dragon promotion batch two - issue 3 complete
banner.provenance: The content-structure arc round five, the second rules promotion batch under the R968 format: three records promoted mechanically from their spec JSONs into content/rules/dragon/ - issue 3 complete (wmn, spr, fsc - the Lakofka women, the Healer and the Scribe, the Samurai and the Berserker), 255 model items, every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof). The batch sizing rides byte weight, not record counts: R895-R897 is 104817 bytes of Lua, R898 alone is 117KB and would burst the canvas ceiling - batch three opens at chr. Cumulative 11 of the walked 79-round Dragon set, 68 remaining.
